 K.L. Connie Wang Wed, 28 October 2026 at 2:16 am UTC 4 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. If you're already missing the K-Dramas featuring the initially "cold" CEO like My Royal Nemesis or My Bias, My Boss , get ready for What a Boss Wants starring the King of the Cold-CEO, Sung Hoon . Hoon, who could arguably be the actor that perfected the icy-chaebol trope, returns to what he knows best in a new rom-com coming to Viki. The new series looks both interesting and funny and we can't wait for it to premiere.
 Let's take a look at everything we know about What a Boss Wants including trailer, cast, and plot details!

 What is What a Boss Wants about?
 Kwon Do Hyuk (Hoon) is a brilliant tech visionary and wealthy CEO who seems to have it all, yet he suffers from persistent insomnia and a deep emotional void. After his business partner betrays him and his father tasks him to save a failing entertainment company, Do Hyuk decides to develop an AI-powered entertainer. His search for the perfect muse leads him to the mysterious indie singer "Soo," who bears an uncanny resemblance to his latest AI creation. In reality, "Soo" is Eun Chae ( Oh Se Young ), a woman juggling a call center job by day and a vibrant stage persona by night. After several awkward encounters, Do Hyuk uses her secrets as leverage, forcing her into a three-month contract as his secretary. But neither of them expect the line between professional duty and personal attraction to blur.
 Is What a Boss Wants based on other material?
 What a Boss Wants is based on a web novel of the same name by Sikeukeu .

 When does What a Boss Wants premiere?
 What a Boss Wants premieres on Wednesday, Nov. 11 with episodes dropping weekly on Wednesdays and Thursdays.
 Where can I watch What a Boss Wants ?
 What a Boss Wants will stream exclusively in the U.S. on Viki.

 Who's in the cast of What a Boss Wants ?
 Sung HoonWhat a Boss Wants
 Sung Hoon as Kwon Do Hyuk
 Sung Hoon returns to his cold-CEO-falls-for-ordinary-girl roots in What a Boss Wants . With chaebol roles in My Secret Romance and Level Up , Hoon developed the cold-CEO into an art form. Hoon has remained largely out of the limelight after he received internet backlash from a social gaffe he made on a variety show back in 2022 though he continued to interact with his global fanbase through his social media channels. He is best known for his roles in Oh My Venus, Perfect Marriage Revenge , and My Secret Romance .
 Oh Se YoungWhat a Boss Wants
 Oh Se Young as Lee Eun Chae
 Oh Se Young is best known for her roles in Lovely Runner, The Beauty Inside , and The Judge Returns .
